title: Close, but Not the Same
caption:
Lined up together,
these lip colours look almost the same.

On the lips, they are not.
One leans warm, another cool.
One stays sheer,
another leaves more colour behind.

Your own lip colour shows through,
and that changes the result.

So when you choose,
try it on your lips,
in daylight if you can.

The closer two shades look,
the more it matters
where you see them.
